text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden — a passionate and hard-working freelancer with 6 years of experience in Python and machine learning, and I’d love to help produce your AI lookbook videos.

I work comfortably with Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning workflows. While my background is technical rather than traditional videography, I’m very familiar with AI-driven content pipelines and can help structure a repeatable process for creating AI-generated visuals, assembling them into polished short-form videos, and keeping the output consistent across a large batch.

One relevant project I’ve built was Coffee review themes for Cobalt Coffee Roasters. I created a small Streamlit app that grouped 38k marketplace reviews into themes and tracked sentiment per theme each week. That project produced 12 stable themes and replaced about 2 days a month of manual tagging. It’s a good example of the kind of workflow thinking I bring to high-volume content production: organize the process, keep outputs consistent, and reduce repetitive work.

For your project, I understand you need AI lookbook videos that are 1 minute and 40 seconds long, with special effects transitions between photos, and delivered in HD quality. I can help build a reliable production approach for these videos so the style stays consistent from one video to the next. If you also want 100 thumbnails, I can support that as part of the same organized workflow.

I’m comfortable working in a way that supports scale, consistency, and quality control, which is especially important when producing many similar videos. If you share the visual style you want, I can help turn that into a repeatable format that matches your reference as closely as possible.

I’d be glad to discuss your process, your preferred style, and how we can make production efficient while keeping the visuals clean and polished.
